channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Disaster Experts Say Nepal Glacier Collapse Was Difficult to Predict
item.description: Given the challenges in forecasting and detecting such calamities, researchers advised banning construction on floodplains and marking out clear evacuation routes.

item.title: NPR: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
item.description: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

item.title: BBC News: Videos show people survive floodwaters on balcony in Nepal
item.description: BBC Verify has located several videos from disaster-struck areas of the Trishuli river after deadly floods swept through.

item.title: The Guardian: An $18bn settlement – and Zuckerberg barely blinked. The tech titans must be stripped of their power, and soon | Jonathan Freedland
item.description: Those who said Meta harms children struck a blow, but the ability of big tech to gouge profits and cause harm is barely diminished. That’s the battle to come Follow the money. If you want to know how the tech giant Meta…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Forced birth control in Greenland violated women’s rights, experts find
item.description: Truth commission to be established after two expert reports failed to agree whether scheme constituted genocide.

item.title: Ars Technica: Trump blacklisting of "woke" Anthropic deemed illegal by federal judge
item.description: Anthropic refused to support lethal autonomous warfare and mass surveillance.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Teen ‘After-Prom’ Kings in LA Monetized the High School Rager
item.description: The West Coast house-party scene has long been iconic. For these young, tech-savvy entrepreneurs, it was also inspiration for MyPlots, a party-promotion empire.

item.title: WIRED Science: There Are So Many Conspiracy Theories About Dolly Parton and Vaccines
item.description: Influential right-wing conspiracy theorists and MAGA-aligned pundits are falsely claiming that the Covid vaccine killed Dolly Parton, the vaccination advocate and philanthropist.

item.title: WIRED Business: Microsoft Teams Has Become a Haven for Scammers in China
item.description: Fraudsters are exploiting enterprise chat apps like Teams and Webex to trick Chinese victims into transferring large sums of money, fueling a wave of complaints.

item.title: The New Yorker: How the Meta Settlement Could Change the Internet
item.description: Even while refusing to admit legal fault, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram has accepted, for the first time, that much of its business model is unacceptable for children.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Best of Ulta’s 21 Days of Beauty Deals
item.description: Discounts on Cécred, M.A.C, Amika, and more.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Fire Island’s Pyramid House Is for Sale
item.description: The distinctive modernist house, designed for a J.P. Morgan descendant, has been updated and listed with a price cut.

item.title: Fox59: Vicious attack on teenager kicked off search for potentially armed suspects in Westfield
